Is there currently any code or an existing plan to formalize Gödel's constructible universe L in mathlib4?

I am aware there are some metamathematical constraints, but I don't know what exactly it is. Is it currently feasible to build L as an inner model of the existing von Neumann hierarchy V in mathlib?

I would like to understand the anticipated technical difficulties. I assume the primary hurdles involve formalizing the definable powerset operatioand arithmetizing the necessary first-order syntax and semantics to iterate this over the ordinals within Lean's framework.
